title: 第17章 元兽秘境试炼第18章 师兄弟闯试炼秘境
slug: 签到大帝修为开局收下禁忌剑体
content_zh:
“拜见小师叔！”
道极宗主先是行了一礼，随后开口道：“半个多月后，就是元兽秘境试炼。
不知小师叔有否有意让陆师弟参加？”
“元兽秘境试炼？”
【叮！
【发布任务：请宿主派弟子前往元兽秘境试炼并且帮助宗门夺得第一名！
【请问宿主是否接取？】
“嗯？”
秦天阳脑海中响起系统的声音，他没想到，这也能触发任务。
“系统，接取任务！”
秦天阳在脑海中回答道。
“小师叔？”
道极宗主见秦天阳有些愣神，于是疑惑的喊了一声。
“长久闭关不是可行的，还需实际磨练。
那就参加吧。”
“并且不止一位弟子，我今天又收了一名弟子，天赋还不错。”
“真的吗？太好了，恭喜小师叔再收弟子一名。”
道极宗主由衷地恭喜道。
只要小师叔肯收弟子什么都好说，可不能让道阳一脉就这么落寞下去。
“师侄先告退了。”

道极宗主转身离开，消失在天边。
“差点忘了还有一事。
如果师叔最近外出的话，还请小心一些。”
刚走没多久，道极宗主又返回来，提醒秦天阳：“听闻前几天，东荒域里的一个顶级势力神霞宗被人袭击了。”
“并且我听说袭击者实力强大无比，一拳便摧毁了神霞宗的护宗大阵，伤了多位重要的长老。”
说完，道极宗主这才离开。
“嗯？神霞宗？”
秦天阳神色一动，他记得之前那个招惹他的宗门就是叫什么神霞宗来着。
掌门师侄说的该不会是他吧。
......
另一边，赵凡此刻正好来到弟子洞府区域前，随意选择了一间洞府住了进去。
弟子洞府都相差不大，除非自己简单装饰一番。
不过大多数人都致力于追求实力，能住人就行。
content_en:
"Greetings to my junior uncle!"
Daoji Sect Leader first bowed, and then said: "In more than half a month, the Yuan Beast Secret Realm trial will begin.
I wonder if Junior Junior Uncle intends to allow Junior Brother Lu to participate? "
"The Yuan Beast Secret Realm Trial?"
[Ding!
[Release mission: Ask the host to send disciples to the Yuan Beast Secret Realm for trial and help the sect win first place!
[Will the host accept it? 】
"Huh?"
The voice of the system sounded in Qin Tianyang's mind. He did not expect that this could also trigger the task.
"System, accept the mission!"
Qin Tianyang answered in his mind.
"Little uncle?"
Seeing that Qin Tianyang was a little stunned, Daoji Sect Leader shouted in confusion.
“Long-term seclusion is not feasible and requires practical training.
Then take part. "
"And there is more than one disciple. I have accepted another disciple today. His talent is pretty good."
"Really? That's great. Congratulations to my junior uncle for accepting another disciple."
Daoji Sect Master said sincerely congratulations.
As long as the young master uncle is willing to accept disciples, anything can be said, but Daoyang's lineage cannot be left alone like this.
"My nephew, please take your leave now."
The Daoji Sect Master turned around and left, disappearing into the horizon.
"I almost forgot one more thing.
Please be careful if your uncle has been out recently. "
Not long after he left, the Daoji Sect Master returned and reminded Qin Tianyang: "I heard that the Shenxia Sect, a top power in the Eastern Wasteland, was attacked a few days ago."
"And I heard that the attacker was so powerful that he destroyed the Shenxia Sect's sect-protecting formation with one punch and injured many important elders."
After saying that, the Daoji Sect Master left.
"Huh? Shenxia Sect?"
Qin Tianyang's expression changed. He remembered that the sect that provoked him before was called Shenxia Sect.
Could it be that the head master's nephew was talking about him?
...
On the other side, Zhao Fan happened to be in front of the disciple cave area at this moment, and randomly chose a cave to live in.
The disciples' caves are not much different, unless they are simply decorated.
However, most people are committed to pursuing strength, as long as they can live with others.
